data.name: MissionIntro
data.value: Be better every day. beeday exists to help people turn intention into progress — one small step at a time.

data.name: MissionStory1Body
data.value: We believe lasting change doesn't come from the intensity of a single day, but from the continuity of small actions over time.

data.name: MissionStory2Body
data.value: Habits, tasks, projects, and personal finance stay together, so your progress stays visible, organized, and easy to follow.

data.name: MissionStory3Body
data.value: beeday connects routine, goals, and personal organization into one simple experience, so you spend less energy trying to control everything and more energy moving forward.

data.name: MissionStory4Body
data.value: beeday isn't here to decide for you. It's here to support your choices, bring clarity to your progress, and make your next step easier to see.

data.name: MissionClosingStatement
data.value: it isn't about doing it all. it's about continuing to move forward.

data.name: EfficacyIntro
data.value: How beeday approaches helping people build better habits.

data.name: EfficacyBody
data.value: beeday is built around a simple idea: small, trackable actions compound into real progress over time. We have not yet published independent studies or usage metrics about beeday's effectiveness. This page will be updated with real evidence as it becomes available — we will not publish results we cannot support.

data.name: EfficacyPendingEvidenceBody
data.value: No studies, surveys, or usage metrics about beeday's effectiveness are published yet. This section is reserved for that evidence once it exists — not for claims we can't back up.
